ex.en: The bargain sale will run for three days, beginning today.
ex.zh: 這次特賣從今天開始，為期三天。

ex.en: I might check for sales or discounts online.
ex.zh: 我可能會上網看看有沒有特價或折扣。

ex.en: The sale prices are written in red ink.
ex.zh: 特價的價格是用紅字寫的。

ex.en: Sales fell off in the third quarter.
ex.zh: 第三季的銷售額下滑了。

ex.en: Who's in charge of the sales section?
ex.zh: 誰負責業務部門？

ex.en: Is this car for sale?
ex.zh: 這輛車要賣嗎？

ex.en: Their house is for sale.
ex.zh: 他們的房子要出售。

ex.en: You can't drink seawater because it is too salty.
ex.zh: 你不能喝海水，因為它太鹹了。

ex.en: This soup is too salty to eat.
ex.zh: 這碗湯太鹹了，喝不下去。

ex.en: This food is too salty.
ex.zh: 這個食物太鹹了。

ex.en: Do you prefer sweet or savory snacks?
ex.zh: 你喜歡甜的還是鹹的點心？

ex.en: The savory pancake was filled with cheese and ham.
ex.zh: 這個鹹煎餅裡夾了起司和火腿。

ex.en: You should put safety before everything else.
ex.zh: 你應該把安全放在其他一切之上。

ex.en: A bus driver is responsible for the safety of the passengers.
ex.zh: 公車司機要負責乘客的安全。

ex.en: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
ex.zh: 如果不遵守安全程序，你可能會受傷。

ex.en: On the whole I am satisfied with the result.
ex.zh: 總的來說，我對這個結果很滿意。

ex.en: I am not satisfied with the result at all.
ex.zh: 我對這個結果一點兒也不滿意。

ex.en: He was satisfied with the work he had done.
ex.zh: 他對自己的勞動成果很滿意。

ex.en: I'd like to open a savings account.
ex.zh: 我想開一個儲蓄帳戶。

ex.en: I put part of my salary into a savings account every month.
ex.zh: 我每個月把部分薪水存進儲蓄帳戶。

ex.en: No matter what your main purpose is in reading, books should never fail to provide contentment and satisfaction.
ex.zh: 不管讀書的主要目的是什麼，書總能帶給人滿足。

ex.en: I won't give them the satisfaction.
ex.zh: 我不會讓他們稱心如意的。

ex.en: Customer satisfaction is our top priority.
ex.zh: 顧客滿意是我們的首要目標。

ex.en: His low salary prevents him from buying the house.
ex.zh: 他薪水太低，買不起房子。

ex.en: His high salary enabled him to live in comfort.
ex.zh: 他的高薪讓他生活過得很舒適。

ex.en: I'll pay you back once I receive my salary.
ex.zh: 我一領到薪水就還你錢。
